Subject: Quick: PO setup & multi-country VAT IDs

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this — we are ready to get Redwood set up as a supplier so you can issue the PO and we can invoice. A few complicating factors on our side: we operate across Spain, Portugal and the Netherlands and have multiple local VAT registrations and a UK VAT registration for the holding company.

Can you confirm:
- Which legal entity and tax ID you need per PO?
- Do you support a single PO per country entity (preferred) or do we need separate POs per VAT registration?
- Any special invoice field requirements (VAT number position, local invoice language) that block AP?

I've attached a spreadsheet with our registered tax IDs and the entity names for each country (globex_tax_id_sheet.csv). We can also share certified VAT registration PDFs if that helps.

Appreciate a short checklist so we can return the completed form and get the PO issued this week.

Best,
Ana Ruiz
Finance Lead — Globex Trade

Subject: Re: Quick: PO setup & multi-country VAT IDs

Thanks Ana — useful summary and the spreadsheet helps. High level next steps from our side:

1) Invoice entity mapping: for AP to accept invoices we need a PO tied to a single legal entity. If you have a local Spanish VAT (UXX123456), the PO for services delivered to Spain should be issued to that Spanish entity (Globex Trade SL).

2) Tax evidence: please upload the VAT certificate(s) for each country. For cross-border EU invoices we typically need the VAT registration cert + standard VAT ID printed on invoices. For the UK entity please include the UTR/VAT registration copy as well.

3) Normalize IDs: the attached CSV is great — can you add two extra columns: (a) preferred invoice entity (legal name exactly as registered) and (b) remit address for that entity. That helps our procurement system match the vendor record and route the PO. I attached our standard PO template for reference (po-template-std.pdf).

4) PO strategy: we can issue a single PO per legal entity. If you prefer one master PO and post-invoice splits, we can discuss but it requires pre-approved cost center routing and extra AP steps (not preferred).

5) Timeline: if you return the completed CSV + VAT certs by EOD tomorrow we'll draft the PO and target issuance by Thursday.

CC'ing Ben (tax & AP flow) and Laura (supplier onboarding) to expedite. Neha, could you confirm any additional EU-specific invoice field requirements (e.g., VAT box mapping) we should pass to the vendor?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Sourcing Manager | Redwood Inference

Ana — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the cert. Confirming next steps from Redwood AP/tax: 

- We reviewed the attached CSV. We'll issue the PO to the Spanish entity listed: Globex Trade SL. PO number: REDW-P-1783. Please include the Spanish VAT number (UXX123456) on the invoice header and match the remit address in the CSV.

- For Portuguese and Dutch invoices: we will create separate vendor records and POs per country VAT registration once we receive the certified VAT doc or registry extract. EuroTax's translation note is sufficient for the Netherlands; please ask them to upload the translated registration extract to the same Drive folder.

- Invoicing fields required: invoice number, invoice date, VAT registration number, itemized description of services, total net, VAT amount, currency, and legal entity name exactly as on the PO. If the invoice is in a local language please provide an English summary page (AP requirement for non-euro-language invoices — not a blocker for ES/PT/NL but helpful).

- Payment & terms: standard 30 days from invoice receipt. AP will only match invoices to the PO number. If you need a single consolidated payment across entities, we can discuss a settlement schedule but it will require a written intercompany agreement.

I'll drop the PO into the vendor portal and email the PDF to accounts@globex-trade.com this morning. Laura will follow up to confirm vendor record creation. Neha will ingest the VAT cert into our tax-evidence tracker and confirm once the Portuguese and Dutch docs are received.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior AP Manager | Redwood Inference
